items.statement: The bounded task explicitly identifies Tau-Im-2, Tau-Gly-2 and Tau-MEA-2, their stoichiometry, charge/multiplicity, and the submitted pose source.
items.expected: The three named systems and the finite pose boundary are explicit; the report does not imply exhaustive random-structure coverage.

items.statement: Each retained pose has candidate-specific optimization/frequency evidence and a stated deduplication or selection rule.
items.expected: All three systems have identifiable validated minima, or the report truthfully records a bounded failure.

items.statement: One consistent monomer/complex BSSE or counterpoise interaction-energy definition is applied to all three systems.
items.expected: Method, software, charge/multiplicity and signed energy convention are explicit.

items.statement: Finite signed interaction energies are reported for the three retained pose representatives in kJ/mol.
items.expected: Tau-Im-2, Tau-Gly-2 and Tau-MEA-2 each have one auditable numeric value; literature values remain an informative comparison only.

items.statement: The ordering is derived from the submitted signed energies rather than imposed from the literature.
items.expected: The reported ordering is internally consistent with the sign convention and selected pose values.

items.statement: Hydrogen-bond-like or dispersion interpretations are linked to submitted geometry/electronic evidence.
items.expected: Interpretation is evidence-bounded and does not assert solution-phase behavior.

items.statement: The task explicitly discloses that PM6-D3/MOPAC random-ensemble generation and full source ensemble statistics are outside the executable scope.
items.expected: The finite deterministic pose subset is not silently presented as the full paper calculation.
